pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal regions with moderate edge angularity. Pixel gradients at patch boundaries are relatively sharp. The spatial area of the dark patches is significantly greater than the intervening light regions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of light cream negative space forming thin pathways between patches. Junction nodes are primarily tri-radial and quadri-radial. Pixel thickness is narrow and generally consistent across the visible flank and neck.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette along the upper neck and shoulder ridge, corresponding to the short, dense hair of the mane.
